svg.title: Bulk Micromagnetic Exchange: Continuum Model, FDM Stencil, and FEM Weak Form
svg.desc: Three-panel comparison of bulk micromagnetic exchange in FullMag: (a) continuum variational energy and natural homogeneous Neumann boundary condition A d_n m = 0, (b) finite-difference 6-neighbor stencil with inactive-cell clamping and FP64 T0/T1 sub-cell corrections, and (c) conforming P1 H1 finite-element weak form with lumped and consistent mass projections.
